leads.name: QB attempts UNDER vs the 8 worst pass D
leads.rule: Bet the under when the book's attempts line is 3+ above the trimmed average of starters vs those defenses. Strongest when the QB's team is favored - teams that lead stop throwing.

leads.name: RB rushing yards OVER vs the 6 worst run D
leads.rule: Trimmed carries x blended yards per carry; bet the OVER when it beats the line by 10+ yards AND the back's team is favored (teams that fall behind stop running). Skip underdogs.
leads.backtest: Overs 10+ above the line: favorites 21-10 (2025 10-7, 2026 11-3), underdogs 13-15. Lead backs overall: team won 59% overs, team lost 26%.
